notes: Said plainly, after a needlessly complicated answer: *"This segment of the UI is already a drop list box on the left side of the predicate. We just need to support either a value or a drop list box on the right hand side that includes all the same things as the other drop list box, for uniformity."* That was the right design and simpler than what I proposed back. 4.4.0 made the model values screenable but left "price below its own model of models" reachable only through the where expression box — a second, unrelated mechanism for what is obviously the same idea. A filter may now carry value_fi
